certifiedResults.metadataNotes: Aggregated from the Georgia Secretary of State official public results Total Votes Excel report. The parser reads the County Results sheet for the President of the US contest and reconciles candidate county sums against the statewide Total Votes sheet.

certifiedResults.title: Georgia official presidential county results
